metadata.title: HPP Newton / Massachusetts Regulatory Rule Inventory
metadata.scope: Newton residential renovation/planning pathways currently represented in HPP, with Massachusetts state code where applicable
metadata.purpose: Structured source-backed rule inventory for TECH consumption and professional audit. Not legal advice and not a substitute for an authority's determination.

rules.question: Building permit baseline
rules.sourceSection: ISD mission; Newton Building Permit Application Checklist; MA 780 CMR §105.1
rules.requiredFacts: exact scope; applicable 780 CMR classification; exemption status
rules.exceptions: statutory/code exemptions; permit subtype may vary
rules.boundaryConditions: Do not equate every home improvement with a building permit without checking §105 exemptions.

rules.question: New construction requires building permit and prerequisite demolition where applicable
rules.sourceSection: Building Permit Application Checklist; new-construction checklist item
rules.requiredFacts: whether existing structure must be demolished; demolition permit status; buildable-lot status
rules.versionOrEffectiveDate: Checklist revised 2023; current checklist availability verified 2026
rules.exceptions: new construction permit will not issue until required demolition permit is issued

rules.question: Structural work / alteration permit pathway
rules.requiredFacts: whether regulated structure is altered; engineered design required; scope
rules.exceptions: minor/nonregulated work may fall within exemptions; exact classification requires code review

rules.question: Demolition permit pathway
rules.authority: Newton ISD / Building Official; NHC for 50+ year structures
rules.triggeringFacts: building age; historic status; percentage/extent of removal; asbestos/dust-control requirements where applicable
rules.requiredFacts: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION
rules.result: Current 2026 ISD demolition notice; historic review separate
rules.versionOrEffectiveDate: historic demolition review is a separate pathway
rules.exceptions: No

rules.question: Is proposed use allowed in zoning district?
rules.sourceSection: Zoning Ordinance Chapter 30; Building Permit Checklist
rules.triggeringFacts: new use or change of use
rules.requiredFacts: zoning district; existing/proposed use; accessory use status; special permit/variance history
rules.exceptions: existing nonconformity and recorded approvals can change result

rules.question: FAR calculation required
rules.triggeringFacts: addition; new construction; replacement/enclosure affecting floor area
rules.requiredFacts: existing GFA; proposed GFA; lot area; scope; existing envelope
rules.exceptions: existing basement/attic finish within existing envelope does not require FAR calculation; additions/new construction do

rules.question: Setback compliance
rules.requiredFacts: zoning district; lot lines; proposed building/equipment location; applicable front/side/rear setback; height/structure type
rules.exceptions: district and structure-specific rules vary; no universal setback

rules.question: Height/story compliance
rules.sourceSection: Zoning Ordinance Chapter 30; §1.5.4 referenced by current ADU guidance
rules.requiredFacts: zoning district; building height; stories; grade; structure type
rules.exceptions: height measurement and exceptions are structure-specific

rules.question: Lot coverage/open space
rules.sourceSection: FAR FAQ identifies lot coverage/open space as separate dimensional controls; Chapter 30
rules.requiredFacts: existing/proposed building and impervious coverage; lot area; district
rules.exceptions: FAR does not substitute for lot coverage/open space analysis

rules.question: Dwelling-unit count / ADU creation
rules.triggeringFacts: new dwelling unit, internal/detached ADU, conversion creating separate unit
rules.requiredFacts: existing units; proposed units; ADU type; CO age; zoning/use; size; ownership
rules.exceptions: one ADU per lot; size/by-right/special-permit rules differ by type and CO age

rules.question: Special permit / site-plan pathway
rules.authority: Planning & Development / ZBA / City Council as applicable
rules.triggeringFacts: development/use/structure where ordinance requires discretionary approval
rules.requiredFacts: project type; district; dimensional/use relief; prior approvals
rules.exceptions: cannot infer special permit solely from addition label

rules.question: Garage/accessory structure conversion
rules.triggeringFacts: garage/carriage-house/accessory structure converted to dwelling or other use
rules.requiredFacts: existing use; proposed use; unit count; setbacks/height; historic status; parking
rules.exceptions: historic carriage-house treatment can interact with ADU dimensional rules

rules.question: Electrical permit
rules.sourceSection: Newton Electrical, Plumbing and Gas page; Massachusetts Electrical Code
rules.requiredFacts: electrical scope; license/application requirements; fire-alarm overlap
rules.versionOrEffectiveDate: MA Electrical Code based on NFPA 70, 2026 effective 2026-04-24
rules.exceptions: fire alarm work can require separate Fire permit in addition to electrical

rules.question: Plumbing permit
rules.requiredFacts: fixtures/piping/sanitary/water scope; cross-connection where applicable
rules.exceptions: exact permit requirements depend on work

rules.question: Gas permit
rules.requiredFacts: gas appliance; piping scope; fuel source
rules.exceptions: gas work may coexist with mechanical/plumbing and fossil-free restrictions

rules.question: Replacement gas water heater requires plumbing and gas permits
rules.sourceSection: FAQ on Newton Electrical, Plumbing and Gas page
rules.requiredFacts: confirm appliance is gas and replacement scope
rules.unknownHandling: NOT_APPLICABLE only when appliance is not gas
rules.exceptions: separate energy/fossil-free rules may also apply depending on project classification

rules.question: Mechanical/HVAC permit pathway
rules.sourceSection: Newton ISD departmental material; NewGov Mechanical module; permit records; 780 CMR mechanical provisions
rules.requiredFacts: equipment type; fuel; new vs replacement; duct/ventilation; gas/electrical/plumbing interactions
rules.exceptions: Newton public material does not expose complete equipment-by-equipment matrix

rules.question: Fire review for building permit
rules.requiredFacts: building permit status; project scope; fire protection systems
rules.unknownHandling: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION only for exact scope/advance-review timing
rules.exceptions: detailed 2024 Fire requirements indicate scope-dependent advance approval and ISD issuance determination

rules.question: Separate fire alarm permit for alarm installation/modification
rules.triggeringFacts: install/modify/update fire alarm or smoke detection system
rules.requiredFacts: system type; residential/commercial; electrical scope
rules.exceptions: Newton states separate Fire and electrical permits for residential fire alarm work

rules.question: Fire protection system construction-document review
rules.sourceSection: Fire Protection Construction Documents / system plans
rules.triggeringFacts: sprinkler, standpipe, fire alarm, smoke control, extinguishing system or other fire-protection equipment
rules.requiredFacts: occupancy/hazard; system type; design/calculations; equipment
rules.exceptions: requirements differ by system and occupancy

rules.question: Local Historic District exterior/site review
rules.triggeringFacts: any exterior/site/hardscape change in one of four districts
rules.requiredFacts: district membership; exterior/site scope; visibility/in-kind status
rules.exceptions: in-kind/ordinary maintenance may qualify for staff/administrative treatment

rules.question: Local Landmark exterior review
rules.triggeringFacts: exterior alteration/property change to designated landmark
rules.requiredFacts: landmark designation; exterior scope
rules.exceptions: designation-specific terms may affect scope

rules.question: Preservation Restriction review
rules.requiredFacts: recorded restriction; affected area; exterior/interior/landscape terms
rules.exceptions: restriction controls vary by deed/restriction

rules.question: National Register / Historical Review
rules.triggeringFacts: alteration/demolition of National Register-listed property within stated review scope
rules.requiredFacts: National Register status; character-defining features; alteration/demolition scope
rules.exceptions: not every National Register property alteration is identical; application guidance governs

rules.question: 50+ year demolition/partial demolition review
rules.triggeringFacts: total or partial demolition of structure 50 years old or older
rules.requiredFacts: age/date; extent of demolition
rules.versionOrEffectiveDate: Current guidance; exact wording varies between pages
rules.exceptions: partial demolition defined as removal/alteration/envelopment of 50%+ of single elevation or roof surface

rules.question: 50+ year exterior alteration historic review
rules.triggeringFacts: exterior alteration to property >50 years old outside district/landmark/restriction pathway
rules.requiredFacts: age; exterior scope; current historic classification
rules.exceptions: do not equate 50+ age with local district/landmark status

rules.question: Tree Permit for any exterior construction
rules.requiredFacts: exterior construction yes/no
rules.unknownHandling: NOT_INDICATED for interior-only work; otherwise trigger is direct
rules.versionOrEffectiveDate: Current ordinance/page; exterior construction requirement verified
rules.exceptions: permit required even if no tree removal

rules.question: Tree removal permit at 6-inch DBH threshold
rules.triggeringFacts: remove tree with trunk diameter 6 inches or greater
rules.requiredFacts: DBH measurement; protected status/exemptions
rules.unknownHandling: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION at 5.99/6/6.01 boundary and exemption status
rules.versionOrEffectiveDate: Current page states 6-inch DBH or greater
rules.exceptions: documented exemptions may exist; exact tree classification should remain source-driven

rules.question: Tree Save Area calculation
rules.requiredFacts: DBH; drip-line radius; work footprint; adjoining-lot tree location
rules.exceptions: Tree Save Area is greater of drip line or 1.5 ft per inch DBH radius

rules.question: Wetlands jurisdiction within 100 ft of vegetated wetland/intermittent stream/pond
rules.sourceSection: Wetlands Permitting Info; Wetlands Protection Act framework
rules.requiredFacts: resource type; measured distance; proposed land alteration
rules.unknownHandling: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION at 99/100/101 ft and resource classification
rules.exceptions: distance alone is insufficient without correct resource classification

rules.question: Wetlands jurisdiction within 200 ft of perennial stream
rules.triggeringFacts: land-altering work within 200 ft of perennial stream
rules.requiredFacts: stream classification; measured distance; land alteration
rules.exceptions: resource classification must be established

rules.question: Floodplain conservation review
rules.sourceSection: Floodplains and Stormwater; City/FEMA floodplain ordinances
rules.triggeringFacts: land alteration in FEMA or City floodplain
rules.requiredFacts: floodplain layer/status; proposed fill/grading/construction
rules.exceptions: FEMA and City floodplains are distinct ordinance layers

rules.question: Stormwater land disturbance threshold
rules.requiredFacts: disturbed area in square feet; applicable exception/waiver
rules.exceptions: exact waiver/exemption handling not exhaustively established

rules.question: Minor stormwater new impervious-area threshold
rules.requiredFacts: new impervious area SF; project category; other thresholds
rules.exceptions: threshold category interacts with land disturbance and project type

rules.question: Residential minor stormwater unit/disturbance threshold
rules.triggeringFacts: residential development/redevelopment <=4 units with land disturbance <0.5 acre
rules.requiredFacts: unit count; disturbed area; exception/waiver status
rules.exceptions: 0.5 acre = 21,780 sq ft; exact interaction with other categories requires ordinance evaluation

rules.question: Retaining wall due to grade change
rules.triggeringFacts: new retaining wall required due to grade changes
rules.requiredFacts: retaining wall existence; reason; grade change
rules.exceptions: do not trigger from decorative wall absent qualifying grade-change condition

rules.question: Trench excavation requiring dewatering
rules.requiredFacts: trench; dewatering required
rules.exceptions: fact-specific

rules.question: Drainage/site-change review
rules.sourceSection: Engineering permit review; Stormwater Ordinance; flood/wetland pages
rules.triggeringFacts: drainage improvement, driveway/public-way work, grading/site drainage changes
rules.requiredFacts: public-way involvement; drainage design; site thresholds; flood/wetland status
rules.exceptions: do not infer a permit category without site facts

rules.question: Basement requires EERO code check
rules.sourceSection: BBRS Official Interpretation 2026-08; 780 CMR EERO provisions
rules.requiredFacts: habitable status; existing EERO; dimensions; sill; grade; well/bulkhead; applicable exceptions
rules.exceptions: existing compliant openings/exceptions can change outcome

rules.question: Basement sleeping room EERO
rules.requiredFacts: each sleeping room EERO; dimensions; sill; well; grade; exceptions
rules.exceptions: do not assume basement common-area EERO substitutes for sleeping-room requirement

rules.question: EERO dimensional compliance
rules.requiredFacts: clear opening area; width; height; sill; well; grade-level exception; operation
rules.exceptions: published exceptions include grade-floor and double-hung conditions; replacement-window exception may apply

rules.question: Engineering review for public-way water/sewer/drainage/driveway work
rules.sourceSection: Engineering Construction Inspection Services; permit review
rules.triggeringFacts: construction involving public way, water/sewer service, drainage, driveway apron
rules.requiredFacts: public-way involvement; utility/drainage scope
rules.exceptions: private interior plumbing is not automatically Engineering public-way work

rules.question: Water/sewer service upgrade trigger in building checklist
rules.triggeringFacts: older dwelling/structure or major gut/size increase
rules.requiredFacts: built before 1970; gut >50%; increase >1,000 sq ft; existing water/sewer service
rules.unknownHandling: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION at threshold and current applicability
rules.exceptions: checklist wording should not be promoted to universal ordinance without current Engineering confirmation

rules.question: Inspection scheduling is permit-holder responsibility
rules.requiredFacts: permit type; stage readiness
rules.exceptions: specific inspection stages vary by project

rules.question: Final inspection required for all permits
rules.requiredFacts: permit exists
rules.unknownHandling: NOT_INDICATED only when no permit exists
rules.exceptions: other departments may have separate final/sign-off processes

rules.question: Building final waits for prerequisite trade/department signoffs
rules.requiredFacts: plumbing/electrical finals; Fire final when required; Engineering/Planning/Conservation/Historic/Health signoffs when required
rules.exceptions: not every department signoff is required for every project

rules.question: Open permits must be identified before project/transaction closeout
rules.requiredFacts: property address; permit records; status
rules.exceptions: check entire list; department-specific permits may be outside ISD

rules.question: Electrical/plumbing/gas and other permits should close before building final
rules.requiredFacts: all related permit statuses
rules.exceptions: other departments own their own closeout

rules.question: Newton Specialized Energy Code applies to complete building applications after 2024-01-01
rules.triggeringFacts: complete building permit application received after 2024-01-01
rules.requiredFacts: application date; building type; applicable code path
rules.unknownHandling: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION if application date/code path unknown
rules.versionOrEffectiveDate: Newton states Specialized Code effective 2024-01-01; MA 10th Edition now current
rules.exceptions: code applicability can depend on project/type and transition rules

rules.question: Fossil-free major renovation/addition threshold
rules.sourceSection: Newton Energy Code page; Newton ordinance Chapter 5 §5-58
rules.triggeringFacts: new construction or Major Renovation Project
rules.requiredFacts: low-rise residential addition >1,000 sq ft OR >100% conditioned floor area; Level 3 alteration >1,000 sq ft and >50% conditioned area; relevant change of use
rules.unknownHandling: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION at exact threshold boundaries and exception/waiver status
rules.exceptions: definition includes multiple alternative tests; exceptions and waivers exist

rules.question: Fossil-free rule after 2026-01-01 for qualifying major renovations/additions
rules.requiredFacts: project classification; date; fuel uses; exception/waiver
rules.versionOrEffectiveDate: Newton says from 2026-01-01 major renovations/additions over 1,000 sq ft must be fully all-electric
rules.exceptions: 2025 gas-cooking exception expired 2026-01-01; ordinance exceptions remain

rules.question: Newton application/permit portal
rules.sourceSection: ISD and Planning pages; NewGov process
rules.requiredFacts: department and application type
rules.unknownHandling: NOT_INDICATED when no application is needed
rules.exceptions: some public records/search use separate portal endpoints

rules.question: Permit record search / property status
rules.requiredFacts: address/property identifier; record completeness
rules.exceptions: GIS layers have stated source dates and should not be treated as live legal determination

rules.question: Newton GIS property permitting/historic/environmental layers
rules.requiredFacts: address; layer status; data vintage
rules.versionOrEffectiveDate: Current GIS browser; flood data source notes effective 2010
rules.exceptions: GIS is screening evidence, not final legal determination

summary.note: A rule may be deterministic only after its required facts are established. This flag means the rule logic can be encoded deterministically from verified inputs, not that HPP can determine the inputs automatically.
summary.highRiskNote: Professional review is recommended before HPP presents these rules as authoritative because they involve code interpretation, discretionary zoning/historic determinations, threshold interactions, or source ambiguity.
